chars.AUNT: AUNT: a 42-year-old Moroccan woman with a warm smile, wearing a burgundy velvet djellaba with gold trim, a loosely tied beige headscarf and gold hoop earrings
chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a 20-year-old Moroccan young man with short curly black hair, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and black joggers
chars.STEPMOM: STEPMOM: a Moroccan woman in her forties with her hair in a bun, wearing a teal kaftan with a white floral print

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the hallway doorway of a modest Moroccan apartment: AUNT has just walked in and is handing a gift bag full of snacks to NARRATOR with a big secretive smile, head-to-waist framing, both faces clearly visible, curious mood

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: AUNT arriving at the front door of a Moroccan house, STEPMOM greeting her with a cheek kiss, AUNT holding a pastry box, friendly family visit, daylight

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan living room with salon cushions: STEPMOM coldly ignoring NARRATOR who sits alone on the far end of the sofa looking lonely, an empty chair where the father usually sits, tense distance between them

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: AUNT sitting next to NARRATOR on a Moroccan salon sofa, leaning in and listening to him with a caring expression while he talks, mint tea glasses on a round brass tray, warm lamp light

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In the hallway of the Moroccan apartment AUNT discreetly slips a small wrapped present into NARRATOR's hands, glancing over her shoulder toward the kitchen so nobody sees, NARRATOR surprised

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: AUNT pulling a big bar of chocolate out of her handbag and giving it to NARRATOR with a playful wink, NARRATOR laughing awkwardly, Moroccan living room background

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: AUNT giving NARRATOR a warm motherly hug in the doorway of his small bedroom, NARRATOR stiff and confused with wide eyes over her shoulder, posters on the bedroom wall

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Evening on the rooftop terrace of a Moroccan house with laundry lines and satellite dishes: AUNT and NARRATOR sitting side by side chatting and smiling, NARRATOR looking at her with a puzzled, curious face, sunset sky
